title: Delete a closed PR's caches with gh cache delete scoped to its merge ref
answers: How do I delete the caches for one pull request with gh?
What does --succeed-on-no-caches do in gh cache delete?
How to clean up GitHub Actions caches for a closed PR in MLflow CI
Delete PR-scoped caches without touching other branches
body:
Command used in .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml (job delete-caches): `gh cache delete --all --ref "refs/pull/$PR_NUMBER/merge" --succeed-on-no-caches --repo "$REPO"`.
Pass PR_NUMBER from `github.event.pull_request.number` and REPO from `github.repository` via env; GH_TOKEN comes from `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN`.
`--ref` limits deletion to the PR's merge ref, so caches for other branches are kept.
`--succeed-on-no-caches` stops the step failing when the PR has no caches.
The job runs on ubuntu-slim with timeout-minutes 5 and needs actions: write.
applies: Cleaning up Actions caches for a single PR from a workflow step; not for deleting all repo caches.
says: Automatically purge build cache storage whenever a pull request is closed.
The pull request cleanup pipeline fails when there are no caches to remove.
Clear cached build artifacts for a closed pull request without clearing other branches.
Free up continuous integration cache space after merging or closing pull requests.
